evan: Heads up found two broken optkit snippets in /optimize/howto and one dead quant-profiles link. Docs CI failed on PR #4050. Can someone pick this up?

mina: I can take the python one. Which call shapes are wrong?

evan: The examples still use `client.generate()` and `client.batch()`; we should show `OptKit()` and `generate_batch()` with batching_policy.

sam: I'll handle the TS embed snippet and the link redirect. Suggest adding a short note about int4 quality caveats.

mina: Drafted change: ```python
from redwood import OptKit
opt = OptKit()
resp = opt.generate_batch([{"prompt":"hi"}], batching_policy="throughput-optimised")
print(resp[0].text)
``` Need to confirm exact arg names but keeps examples compact.

sam: TS snippet updated and pointing quant link to /optimize/quant-profiles/v2. Also added a single-line caveat about int4 for sensitive prompts.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201  evan. CI: running.

evan: Quick lint nit: prefer `batching_policy='latency-optimised'` in quickstart to show latency tradeoff. We can show throughput in a separate example.

mina: Swapped policy to latency in quickstart example and added a one-line explainer. Pushed.

docs-bot: CI passed on staging. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201. Release note: "optkit docs: migrate examples to OptKit, fix quant-profiles link"

evan: Thanks all  please add a follow-up ticket to backport to v1 site and add a tiny test that renders codeblocks in CI.
